investigation: Missing Brain Icon & CORTEX Header Investigation

root_cause_analysis.issue: Brain icon (🧠) and CORTEX header not appearing consistently on all response turns
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Direct print() statements bypassing wrap_cortex_response() wrapper
root_cause_analysis.impact: Inconsistent branding - some responses have header, others don't
root_cause_analysis.detection_method: Audit log analysis + code path tracing + diagnostic execution

finding_1.title: Brain Emoji Renders Correctly
finding_1.evidence: Diagnostic test confirmed UTF-8 encoding works, emoji renders as 🧠

finding_2.title: ResponseHeaderFooterManager Works
finding_2.evidence: Manager initializes successfully, generates headers with brain icon

finding_3.title: wrap_cortex_response Function Works
finding_3.evidence: Function wraps content correctly with header/footer

finding_4.title: Inconsistent wrap_cortex_response Usage
finding_4.evidence: Only 3 wrap_cortex_response calls in main.py, but 19+ print statements bypass wrapper
finding_4.detail: Error messages, status updates go directly to stdout without wrapping
finding_4.impact: Only successful responses get header; errors/status don't

finding_5.title: Multiple Response Pathways
finding_5.evidence: Responses flow through FastCommandHandler, MasterOrchestrator, entry.process()
finding_5.implication: Not all paths wrap responses consistently

root_cause_summary: The infrastructure for header injection IS working correctly. However, not all code paths use it consistently. Direct print() calls in error handlers and setup code bypass the wrapper, resulting in responses without the brain icon header appearing inconsistently.

implementation: Provides cortex_print() and cortex_format() functions as unified interface
Ensures ALL output - errors, status, responses - goes through header wrapper
Maintains fallback header generation if manager unavailable

coverage.after: All output paths unified through cortex_format/cortex_print

diagnostic_1.output: Emoji: 🧠, Encoding: UTF-8, System encoding: utf-8

diagnostic_2.output: Manager initialized, config loaded, timestamp generated

diagnostic_3.output: Input: 37 chars, Output: 323 chars (header added), Brain icon present

diagnostic_4.output: First 150 chars of wrapped response contain: ## 🧠 CORTEX Testing

test_execution: Code path analysis confirmed root cause

immediate: Update all print() statements to use cortex_format() wrapper
Verify header appears on next response

Add integration test: verify every response includes brain icon
Document: all responses must go through cortex_output_formatter
prevention: Code review checklist item: 'Does every response path use cortex_format?'
Audit CI/CD: test that all outputs include CORTEX header
Monitor: track response consistency via audit logs

next_steps: Deploy cortex_output_formatter.py and update all critical print statements in main.py
